description: Admins signed in with a passkey review submissions by status. Opening a row shows the stored gate report, code files and sizes, two-sentence AI summary and findings with scan coverage, GitHub provenance, and the diff against the published version. Clean and Flagged plugins auto-publish immediately while Blocked submissions require an explicit maintainer override quoting the report digest. Reject and an AI-only override ask for a written reason; override covers skills, themes and both plugin runtimes. Missing scans and integrity failures cannot be overridden. The publish worker signs and publishes approved submissions; 1-click revoke takes a submission or all active versions of an item back immediately.
examples: Review a plugin's code inventory and AI findings, then approve publication or reject with a reason.
Revoke a published item and the signed revocation reaches apps at their next index refresh.
how_to: Sign in with your passkey and open a status tab.
Open a row to read code inventory, AI findings and coverage, the gate report and diff; approve, reject or override an AI-only block with a reason.
Open a published row and press revoke with a reason to take it back.
name: Warez admin portal
summary: the admin page at admin.carnivore.ai that shows every submission by status, the gate report, one-click approve and revoke.
